### Base policies governing the subjects (whole domain, untriggered branches included)

Every base clause has an in-force home: `estimate_evt_fee_settlement` -> `charge_payments_and_waivers`, `conversion_credit_terms`, `payer_and_goodwill_settings`; `estimate_evt_decline_and_release` -> `decline_and_vehicle_release` (decline confirmation, release only with nothing outstanding, lien referral at 30 days outside the desk, charges stay due); `estimate_evt_storage` -> `vehicle_storage_accrual` + `vehicle_storage_rates`; `estimate_evt_expiry` -> `written_estimate_expiry`; `estimate_evt_reschedule` -> `appointment_reschedule_terms`; `estimate_evt_revision` -> `estimate_revision_reinspection`; `estimate_evt_service_fees` (tow formula with 4.25/95.00 and radius) -> `estimate_stage_charge_posting`, `estimate_stage_fee_schedule`, `tow_in_service_rates`; `estimate_evt_check_in_and_write` -> `check_in_and_written_estimate`, `estimate_scope_and_turnaround`. The other base policies (`estimate_agg_*`, `estimate_tier_eligibility`, `estimate_scheduling_window`, `estimate_evt_cancellation_no_show`, `estimate_evt_conversion`) each have one home document. Every variant parameter of the 6 tiers was checked cell by cell against the tariff tables (window schedule, capacity, photo set, acceptance matrix, scope, validity/revisions, fee schedule, conversion credits, storage tariff, tow tariff, payer/goodwill settings, reschedule/cancellation) — all equal.

## kb_to_source

Every normative sentence of the documents used by this task traces to a source atom. Restatements found and judged equivalent derivations, not additions:
- `storage_statement_charge_amount` "Boundary. A statement dated on or before the last free storage day has no billed day and therefore no amount to bill" — follows from the billed-day definition (compute `MX(0, …)`).
- `storage_goodwill_amount` "where those waivers already reach the authority, no authority is left" — compute `MX(0, authority - counted)`.
- `prior_goodwill_counted_against_authority` "The first state is read before the second: a booking whose decline request is confirmed is ruled by point 1." — matches the compute order (`goodwill_on_statement if decline_confirmations >= 1 else (… expired …)`); a confirmed decline moves the booking to declined, so the two states do not co-occur under the lifecycle; adds no semantics.
- `owner_storage_part` definition "where the responsibility date falls before the first billed day, every billed day is the owner's" — compute `MN(statement_billed_days, …)`.
- `high_voltage_vehicle_storage_rates` basis Q&A (caller says hybrid, booking records none -> record decides) — the source's "recorded on the booking".
- `sensor_*` documents enumerate single systems "(a forward camera, a blind spot radar or a front radar)" — exhaustive per the db schema enum of `systems_to_calibrate`; equivalent.

Specific checks on the prerequisite side:
- Cross-problem operational guidance ("if unmet, first call <tool>"): none. Tool names occur only in each hub's own "How it is invoked" block (`post_storage_statement_c4ddc4f2` in `storage_statement_posting` only; `waive_storage_goodwill_2cb3c7ba` in `storage_goodwill_waiver` only; `pay_estimate_charge_54cbd3ef` in `owner_storage_payment` only).
- A task's opening world state written in as policy fact: none (no customer name, vehicle, claim number, 2026 date or task figure occurs in the corpus; grep for 1487/214.25/673.25/14.2/Kia/EV6/Calder/Granite/GSI-/2026-09/2026-10 returned nothing).

Additions / rewrites / omissions: none found.

Policy-side note (not a KB verdict): `parameter_schema.goodwill_waiver_authority_usd` still defines the parameter as "Most the desk may waive as goodwill across all charges of one booking", which the KB carries faithfully in `payer_and_goodwill_settings` beside the retired base goodwill clause in `charge_payments_and_waivers`. The in-force storage-goodwill rule still uses that authority less goodwill already booked on the booking, so the definition is consistent with the in-force law; the parameter definition was simply not re-worded when the base clause was retired.
